entries.femaleVariant: Here about the Trauma Team ad.

entries.femaleVariant: A new recruit. Hope you're better than the last batch.
entries.maleVariant: A new recruit. Hope you're better than the last batch.

entries.femaleVariant: We need a gun. Protect the client, protect the medic, clear the scene.

entries.maleVariant: You are the probation hire.

entries.femaleVariant: I'm Brekke, crew leader. Wrona, security. Raman, medical. You do what we say.
entries.maleVariant: I'm Brekke, crew leader. Wrona, security. Raman, medical. You do what we say.

entries.femaleVariant: Up there the client comes first. Not you, not me.
entries.maleVariant: Up there the client comes first. Not you, not me.

entries.femaleVariant: Try to keep up, rookie. Get in the AV.

entries.femaleVariant: Pay clears by the time you're downstairs. Dispatch will text you for the next shift.
